profile.headline: Development Manager of Tour & Cruise Technology
profile.summary:
IT profession with over 25 years of software development experience with emphasis on delivering high-quality, reliable, efficient and maintainable solutions for complex and evolving business requirements.

Proven technical leadership that includes reviewing and understanding requirements, analysis, estimating, functional and detail designs, development, testing and implementation activities. Highly effective in communicating information to customers and colleagues. Has demonstrated the ability to quickly adjust to changes that occur during a projects.

Specialties: C#, .Net, SQL, Azure, Agile, Scrum, DevOps, RabbitMQ, Oracle, MongoDB, XML/JSON, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Visual Studio

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Senior contributor for the inventory and operations departments for both escorted touring and river cruise vacations. The emphasis is to ensure vacation inventory and availability data is accurate to maximize sales. In addition, after the sale ensure all purchased components of a customer’s vacation is communicated to all required operational offices and vendors around the world.  Designed and implemented event driven architecture with internal and global systems using both RabbitMQ and Azure Service Bus technologies.  Redesigned the processes using Microsoft Azure assets as the foundations to the architecture.  This implementation includes the use of Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus queues and an Azure Web job.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · .Net · SQL · Microsoft Azure · Agile Methodologies · Scrum · DevOps · RabbitMQ · Oracle · Toad · MongoDB · Microsoft Office · Visual Studio

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Application developer for the IRS/IRA subsystem. 
Utilize AS/400 I-Series environment technologies COBOL, CL, DB2, SQL, Turnover.
Coordinated the research, corrections, testing of federally mandated and customer requested enhancements to the IRS/IRA system.

positions.title: Senior Lead Analyst / Project Lead
positions.description:
Project lead of four developers for the Citi Cards Rewards application. 
Coordinated the research, corrections, testing and implementation of numerous business enhancements to the production environment. Tracked the progress of over 50 ever changing system enhancement task identified by the business to ensure accuracy and punctual delivery. Collaborated with colleges in the development and implementation of a new software development-estimating tool.

positions.title: Senior Lead Analyst/Technical Lead
positions.description: Technical Lead for the Citi Merchant Services system. Designed IT mainframe solutions to automate the financial balancing of the International Establishment system. Analyzed International Establishment System fee processing and elaborated on its current structure to handle MasterCard’s new and changing assessment fees programs. Analyzed and designed a solution that will allow the International Establishment System’s posting process to reverse duplicated transaction fee’s at the rate of the original transaction. Coordinated the International Establishment System migration to the Language Environment (LE) runtime environment. Designed an online tool that will allow the business to reconcile Pinless debit card transactions that have been sent to the debit networks to what has been paid to Citi Merchant Services. Calculated estimates and authored functional and detail designs documents.

positions.title: Senior Lead Analyst/Team Lead
positions.description: Lead a core team of four developers for the Diners Club North America credit card authorizations system. With extensive teamwork delivered a new authorization system with saves of a million dollars in fraud and credit losses in the first year post implementation. Converted Canadian and United States authorization traffic to the new authorization system. Designed, coded, tested a new real-time acquiring connection for authorizing international and domestic Diners Club credit cards used at Marriott Hotels and Princes Cruise Lines. Calculated estimates and authored functional and detail designs documents. Mentored and trained new department staff.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst/Team Lead
positions.description:
Enhanced and maintained the student loan origination system and the student loan-servicing system.Developed, enhanced and maintained online and batch programs.
Wrote technical design document following businesses methodology. Coordinated users needs and request to technical feasibility. Researched and corrected production problems. Monitored monetary disbursement transmissions via FTP, SMTP and Mainframe to Mainframe. Lead small to medium size projects.
Managed team of five programmers on student loan origination and servicing system. Prioritized and assigned projects to team members. Ensured team was on task and meeting all deadlines. First point of contact for all project questions and concerns. Wrote team members annual evaluations. Initial level of escalation for on-call production issues.

positions.title: Professional Services Consultant
positions.description:
Researched impact of Y2K on client’s magazine publications mainframe environment. Key player in developing a strategy to meet the Y2K requirements. 
Developed and implemented Y2K plan. Upgraded from OSVS COBOL to COBOL for MVS. Wrote and utilized complex test scripts for online and batch processes.
Developed, Enhanced, Maintained, Tested and Implemented online and batch program.
